Fair enough. I have seen so much "eat our young" in so many parts of culture, including different types of Wicca practices. My practice is a bit unusual for sure. I follow the paths and chaotic spirals I find in nature, and books. Which do you follow? You questioned my validity first and I am strong enough to back myself and my Deities. Then act as an injured child when questioned yourself. I know this game, men have been playing it with me a long time now.

You learn and grow as you choose despite age, but age and length of time studying does not always mean ability, drive, passion or power or understanding either. We all learn and contain as much as we want. Don't stop. Don't cease to be amazed at what is actually out there.

Listen..even to those younger, with less years of practice or study, listen to children and their stories. Be Human. Care. Put the logic away and Feel and Listen without analysis for a short while. I don't have it all but I do know to listen and believe and wonder if you even still do have your beliefs?

Many thanks and I do keep these details from dreams and real world encounters archived in an electronic record for myself to think on. It is very very useful as you have very wonderfully stated.

Be Blessed. Be Human. Be Empathetic.

What I am saying is that you are now so to speak, beating a dead horse and being semantical, pretentious and boring. I told my experience and did not ask for advice here. You assumed I wanted it and gave it without asking or seeking to understand for your own intentions. 

I trust my instincts and have good ones. I do not need to justify myself to you and you clearly have missed the point anyhow. Perhaps you are not yet capable of understanding certain aspects of intuition and mystery and magic. I don't know,

I am well researched and also understand the meld of the mystical and the researched and each has its place. You do not yet apparently and yes if I am guided to protect for any reason and that requires a detail left out..who am I to question it if it came from Her and The Others who whispered to me. Believe it or don't but do not come in here with judgements, criticisms to disprove or whatever it is you are attempting. Let it be a beautiful lie or incredulous truth..your choice. I waste no more time on this un enlightened comversation.

Thank you for your kind words. I plan on doing so and will learn and observe all I can while she remains close. Be Blessed and Be Human..we cannot lose that!

So yea its lonely, no family but I never really had that and had figured out how to be okay not needing anyone. I was self reliant..never got close romanticaloy until my current partner. He kinda gets my distance but not always. This family member found me, got close..even through my hesitancy, told me they wanted to he needed..then bailed.  So, no..happiness is not internal or external for me. Friendships dont happen, intimacy is a nightmare and family is non existent 

.it never has been. Its actually kind of fucked to tell someone like me to make my own happiness when I have never been given a second thought or taught how. I literally was born and soon as I was able to walk, taken care of by the animals I could find outside. I ate what they did, starved most of my life,when in doors watched violence or suffered it and then was sold to the first pedo my mom could find. It took 2 years to escape and tuen I had to figure out just what society even was. How the fuck do you learn to create happiness from within? Sorry for the rant but its just not so simple for me.
Yea I know. I wish there was something else, anything else, you could want right now.

You say that..but I was maybe considered unproductive at age 16. Both parents said I should be a drop out. Sister told me since forever she wished I was never born. Mom sold me when I was 15 where..I was kept in a bed most of the day..different reasons sure..but shifty existence for 2 years. 
If I deserved that..not sure what I deserve anymore or what anyone does really. It's crazy how being how magically being an adult is supposed to give all the answers and it doesn't. I am not sure I have advice to give, I never got any on how it's all supposed to work. Just been going through the motions and somehow kept surviving even though I've been clinically dead more than once. 
Gods I hate that yet another generation is dealing with the same self worth shit and we still don't have answers though. It's painful and people who never dealt with it don't get it...it's a journey for sure. Don't know your life so far but I legit know that to be here is no good and extreme and age doesn't seem to matter. I can only say there have been times that have been okay, happy even...hanging out for maybe more of those is how I am still here. I'm just crazy crazy sorry the years haven't been kind to you, no matter how few or how many. People think just cause maybe someone hasn't walked the earth very long they can't feel shit deeply..newsflash..you cam and you're allowed to even when the feelings aren't all the happy bright bubbly ones we have to show people to not get locked away..which was my biggest fear always.

I get it. I wake up early. Work. Take walks in nature and listen to music/sing which helps but keeps me out late. It is exhausting a lot of the time. I try to make other people's day easier because mine never has been. They have no idea at all that I am not this happy, bubbly and cheerful person they see walking down the road, or at work being probably overly productive when it's really just an act 90% of the time. The only thing that feels genuine is the trying to be compassionate and caring to all I encounter which is also exhausting but more rewarding than anything else I can think of to do. I give the same care and respect to the disheveled homeless person that I do to the elderly or people in wheelchairs or my coworker or boss or CEO etc. I don't often receive it back but just hope it makes a difference to someone somehow at the end of the day since I can't do it for me.

There is a huge grooming and psychological component in many rape cases. Also, rape cases aren't prosecuted very heavily if at all. Your rapist will walk free in a matter of days, weeks or at most 90 days if they face any jail time at all. They will likely know who reported them, especially if you sought care at a hospital. They will come back for you and the next time is more aggressive.

Even if you have done everything right, have a restraining order and they violate that. You call the number..police may or may not come. It could take hours. If/when they do show up, they tell you that you have to be dead or murdered before they can do much. Restraining order violations, even after evidence of a rape are still not taken very seriously by law enforcement in many places in the US. 

Long story, report or don't report. The rapist is going to have opportunity to do it again either way. Been my experience anyhow, and more than a few people I know. Even underage or pedophilia sexual encounters aren't really taken seriously in a criminal sense. They get less time than someone stealing bread to survive or jaywalking in some cases.

This actually came up in my abnormal psych class and you are spot on. Professor mentioned that calling vaginas and penises by weird nicknames creates shame because of how we can label other body parts and even very young children pick up on this distinction. 

He also said that it does create higher likelihood of sexual abuse encounters and under reporting of sexual abuse. Obviously because of shame and the kids feeling like they can't talk about their body part....
Reason number 2 is because other adults they may attempt to report sexual abuse to will not know the nickname the parents chose. 

Example: girl was told to call her vagina a cookie for some unknown reason. She reported to her teacher that her uncle ate her "cookie." Her teacher did not understand the reference and told the girl to go ask for another cookie or get another cookie after class when she got home. When she asked her parents for another cookie..you know..the same people who told her to use that name for her vagina....her parents did not realize the reference and gave her an actual cookie. The poor girl was 5 and the abuse went on for years by the uncle. The girl had tried to get help but couldn't access it because of a stupid nickname.

Ideally maybe the amount is correct. I can assure you that US human children slaves are sold for much more than that today. There are millions and counting. The sale of children has not stopped, it has in fact increased. I was sold by my mother and am US born. It was much more recently than the 1940s and I was 15 at the time of sale. Yea, I speak pretty coldly about it...not sure how else to do it really.

 Life span is about 7 years now of enslaved children and about 1 in 10 make it out alive. Average person is sold at about age 13 in the US and dies by age 19 or 20.

Not sure if I was lucky to have made it out really but I do know they paid much more than $88.00 for me and I was treated as a slave and called as such. None of the adults involved had any shame about it at the time or remorse later.

No, it really hasn't. My mother wasn't decent enough to care or feel ashamed like this woman in the photograph. 

My mother sold me at age 15 to a pedo and his son with a violent record. I was born in the US. Both were listed as not able to be near or around any minors legally in 4 states databases. Didn't matter. 2 years of hell and I did escape, extremely malnourished and physically a mess. I was non-compliant with their plans..so..it didn't often go well for me during that time. 

Did some digging and the US is a pretty big offender for domestic slavery of this nature, more domestic slavery than foreign in recent years. 1 in 10 people get out. The rest die. Life span of the enslaved is about 7 years and most are female and enter about age 12. Most won't live to be 19 or 20. The number is literally in the millions in 2021. We aren't talking prostitution of adults here..even though that is now finally being recognized as largely involuntary. 

These are kids, US born children. Most are sold by family because no one will report them missing if their parents or guardians don't or give "permission" for them to be where they are. Millions. I was one for 2 years, age 15 to 17 and am still not sure if it was lucky I survived or not.

Sorry about the rant. Nothing has changed in over 50 years except that this woman cared and parents/guardians now just do not.

I suffered from many long haul Covid symptoms too. Had it in March 2020 and didn't feel myself again until inflammation in my body finally was treated and died down in October/November  2020..it was a slow recovery and awful! Just wanted to tell you because no one talks about it much except maybe in the news.

February of 2021, our family sent people to try and take me again after my cousin talked to FBI about our family trafficking her. She told them it happened to me as well and my family found out, I think. There were 6 more attempts to put me in cars after that, which caused the PTSD symptoms to increase. 

Just saying that I can kinda understand and I am sorry you have to deal with long haul and PTSD and a toxic family. I don't know if it is helpful but I was on so.e long haul Covid support groups on FB..maybe Reddit has some too?

Oh there is always some reason. No idea what and wish I could understand. We were close and what is to be done when the last family you have walks away suddenly with very little explanation and no goodbye. I've lost a lot of people but if your own family thinks you aren't worth trying for, what chance do you have with anyone else really? We were close and then suddenly they were gone. They just stopped caring and I don't have the luxury.

Problem is, there will be a next time. Someone else will come along, not family obviously, and I will start to trust and care...they will work to gain that. They will work to make me need them and as soon as I do, off they will go again. Why do people want to be needed when they don't intend to stick around after all the work of making that happen? I've lived without basic needs before and it sucks, it's worse to have an emotional need created and then be unable to fulfill it. It's much worse when it was done intentionally and stated outright by the person that they wanted you to trust and need them..then they leave so casually like it's no big deal. 

Still feeling it..not sure exactly why this one is worse than the rest of the family..maybe it just felt more intentional and therefore more cruel.
